Hey guy, I'll listen to rap! Here you go! Cool! Money, cars, and girls! I want it all right now! I'm a super wealthy man! Don't ask me why and how! It's a pretty lucky day today! Love is all that I really need! Hey, Jacob! This is your share! It's nice doing business with you! Greetings, dear viewers! So, the first trick is the inexplicable disappearance of the thumb! Meet my boyfriend, Jacob! Not so fast, Vanessa! Come here, boy! Nice to meet you, Mr. Johnson. Oh, what a strong handshake. He's breaking his arm. Jacob, have a seat. James, give this guy a chance. That's interesting. From now on, give us more details, please. And there will be some mustard, of course! Well, I was delighted to meet you! But unfortunately, I have to go! My daughter is very lucky to have you! See you! Oh, with this guy, we will make millions of dollars! It looks like Jacob is already on his way to wealth! And Maya has nothing to do with it! I want to double my payment! There have been some difficulties with our father! No problem, dude! It seems like providing services of a nice guy is a pretty lucrative business. Wow, man! That was brilliant! Pick me as a partner! You need an entry fee! Will my glasses do? Yeah, they will! Come on! After a hard day at work, every millionaire needs a rest. Mermaid Water will transform an ordinary bathroom into a true paradise lagoon! Mermaid Water is also available to order at www.naivemillionaire.com. What a great idea for a business! Oh, not this advertising again! Just as it was getting interesting! I hate ads! Hi buddy! Hi Nick! What happened to your face? What's that? Are you talking about this? Let me explain it to you! This is just my job! I advertise products right on my face! Is it really that profitable? Of course! See for yourself! I'd like to do that too! I have a lot of space for ads! No problem! I'll take you as a partner! It's true what they say! From hate to love, there's only one step! Especially when it comes to money! Every successful businesswoman has her own little secrets! Fresh milk, delicious and healthy snacks! Come on, don't be shy! We have only natural products! Wow! It's too expensive for a glass of milk! This is a robbery! Oh, this is a really good price! I'd better take some spicy nuts! Great choice! Enjoy your meal! Cool! I'm so hungry! Oh, they are spicier than I thought! I need milk, now! How much? I'll take two glasses, hurry! Wow, what a cunning business life hack! It will be more comfortable this way! Don't worry, you'll feel better now! Well, if you want to live a wealthy life, try to be smart! Did you like our video?
